Good Gardener Foundation

ArticleTalk

From Good Gardener, the free encyclopedia

The Good Gardener Foundation for Wild Flowers and Native Plants — or GGF, is an organization founded in 2026 to promote the understanding and preservation of California native plants. It continues the work of Theodore Payne, an English horticulturist, gardener, landscape designer, and botanist.[1]

The Foundation is located in Mount Washington, in the northeast of Los Angeles and in Chinatown
